title: Theo and the Static
author: Odile Ishikawa
blurb: Isandro Marchetti, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the jump window closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
